correctness.rationale: Independent reconstruction proves every dyadic factor is a rotation of one of four available templates, weights are n/2-1,n/2,n/2,n/2+1, outer weights are odd and hence distinguish the n rotations by their moment residue modulo n, and reversal-complement pairs the outer and central classes. A strict induction gives the signed-prefix range [-1,k-1] and weighted moment n(n-k+3)/4, yielding the exact central progression. The definitions, n=4 boundary, rotation quantifiers and paperfolding complement convention are explicitly checked. The standalone checker independently matches literal-word and template profiles at k=2..10 (plus direct counter through k=7); finite checks supplement the infinite proof.

value.rationale: Paperfolding is a classical 2-automatic word whose Abelian and ordinary complexities were separately determined. Exact two-binomial complexity is a natural intermediate string invariant; the result proves a nontrivial linear-versus-logarithmic layer split, a central arithmetic progression, and a closed formula at every dyadic length. These facts are not automatic from 4n ordinary complexity or Abelian 3-class counts, and give useful structural benchmarks for ordered scattered-subsequence comparison.
